description: The 'scenario_runs_cached' dataset provides detailed information about various scenario executions within a system. Each entry in the dataset represents a unique scenario run, identified by a combination of project keys, scenario IDs, and run IDs. The dataset captures the start and end times of each scenario run, allowing for precise tracking of execution durations. Additionally, it records the outcome of each run, such as success, failure, or abortion, and counts any warnings that occurred during execution. The dataset also includes descriptive names for scenarios and triggers, providing context for each run. User-related information, such as the executing user and their identifier, is also captured, along with the method or context of execution. This dataset is particularly useful for system administrators and developers who need to monitor, analyze, and optimize scenario executions, troubleshoot issues, and ensure efficient system operations. Its comprehensive nature makes it a valuable resource for performance analysis and auditing purposes.
shortDesc: Dataset of scenario runs with identifiers and timestamps.

columns.name: scenario_project_key
columns.comment: Project identifier for the scenario, project key.

columns.name: scenario_id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each scenario, scenario key.

columns.name: scenario_run_id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each scenario run, run key.

columns.name: time_start
columns.comment: Timestamp when the scenario run started, start time.

columns.name: time_end
columns.comment: Timestamp when the scenario run ended, end time.

columns.name: outcome
columns.comment: Result of the scenario run, run outcome status.

columns.name: warnings_count

columns.name: scenario_name

columns.name: trigger_name

columns.name: scenario_run_as_user

columns.name: run_as_user_via
columns.comment: Method or context of user execution, execution context.
